title: Avro Lancaster JB477
memorial_details: description: BATTLE OF BERLIN/ November 1943 - March 1944/ Near this spot on December 17th 1943/ R. C. A. F. from Gransden Lodge/ crashed killing six of the crew of seven./ W. O. S. C. H. NUTTING D. F. M. the rear/ gunner who was on his 45th raid survived./ IN MEMORY OF/ (Names)/ And who are buried at/ CAMBRIDGE CITY CEMETERY/ (Names)/ We will remember them.
